seo_title: Cost of Living in Krabi 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Krabi per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A province in southern Thailand with karst cliffs and the turquoise Andaman Sea: visa-free for 60 days, quieter than Phuket and surrounded by nature. The downsides are the rainy season and the need for a motorbike to get around.
pros: Visa-free for 60 days for Russian citizens
Stunning nature: karst cliffs and islands
Calmer and more authentic than Phuket
Affordable prices and great Thai cuisine
The Andaman Sea and world-class beaches
cons: The rainy season (roughly May to October)
You need a motorbike — there's little public transport
Island-level healthcare — for complex cases people go to Phuket or Bangkok
Fewer things to do than in Phuket

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: Up to 60 days without a visa for Russian citizens, with the option to extend by 30 days.

visa_steps.title: DTV visa (for long-term living)
visa_steps.description: A 5-year multiple-entry visa for remote workers — up to 180 days per entry.

visa_steps.title: Renting a home
visa_steps.description: Houses and apartments are rented by the month; Ao Nang has the widest choice.

visa_steps.title: Connectivity and money
visa_steps.description: A local SIM card with plenty of data; you'll need baht in cash and a foreign bank card.

visa_steps.title: Transport
visa_steps.description: You need a motorbike to get around; boats from Ao Nang reach the islands.

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Krabi?
faq.answer: No, it's visa-free for up to 60 days with the option to extend. For long-term living, the DTV visa is convenient.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Krabi?
faq.answer: Affordable, comparable to the rest of southern Thailand. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: What language is spoken in Krabi?
faq.answer: Thai; English is common in tourist areas.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Krabi?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You need baht in cash and a foreign bank card.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Krabi?
faq.answer: Tropical: hot year-round, with a rainy season roughly from May to October.

faq.question: How is Krabi different from Phuket?
faq.answer: Krabi is calmer, cheaper and more natural; Phuket is bigger, with more infrastructure and nightlife.

reviews.text: Krabi is cliffs, sea and quiet — more beautiful than Phuket and cheaper. The downsides: you need a motorbike, it pours during the rains, and you go to Phuket for healthcare.
I fell in love with Krabi's nature: lagoons, islands, jungle. There's less to do than in Phuket, but it's calm and authentic.
